BLOCK17.html: RTP Timestamps Are Not Wall Clocks

BLOCK20.html: WebRTC Connectivity Is Not “STUN or TURN” — It Is an ICE Candidate Selection Problem

BLOCK21.html: STUN discovers reachability information and TURN provides a relay, but ICE is the algorithm that gathers candidates, checks candidate pairs, prioritizes working paths, and nominates the connection media actually uses.
